description:
Fetcher.cr is 396 lines and handles multiple responsibilities:
1. Main entry point and loop orchestration (fetch, fetch_loop)
2. HTTP client creation and request execution (fetch_single)
3. Redirect handling and validation (handle_redirect, fetch_result_uri)
4. Rate limiting and DNS management (check_rate_and_dns)

This violates the single responsibility principle and makes testing difficult. The HTTP request logic (especially fetch_single and check_rate_and_dns) should be extracted into a separate class like  that handles:
- Semaphore acquisition
- HTTP client lifecycle  
- Response validation
- DNS/Rate limit checks
- Error handling with proper resource cleanup

This would also make it easier to test the request logic in isolation without mocking the entire Fetcher.
title: Extract Fetcher HTTP request logic into separate Fetcher::SingleRequest class
